title: TFE3-rearranged ossifying fibromyxoid tumors are uniquely negative for glycoprotein non-metastatic melanoma protein B: A study of 13 TFE3-rearranged mesenchymal tumors.
labeled_methods_only: Our archive was interrogated for TFE3-rearranged non-renal neoplasms previously assessed with our RNA NGS panel. For each case, a whole-slide section was immunostained for GPNMB, and quantified using H-scores.
scope_limit: Only selection eligibility and GPNMB IHC method retained; an incidental other-assay sentence in structured Methods was displayed but excluded, no other-assay data inspected.
